repository_settings.description: Oteryn web/application platform and game gateway.

review_policy.activation_condition: After a second trusted maintainer is available, require one approval, code-owner review and last-push approval. The pull-request requirement, status checks and conversation resolution remain mandatory now.

deferred_decisions.license_notice: composer.json already declares proprietary licensing. The owner may later add an explicit proprietary LICENSE or NOTICE file, or deliberately replace the proprietary declaration with a reviewed open-source license.
deferred_decisions.required_review_upgrade: Requires a second trusted maintainer to avoid deadlocking single-owner pull requests.
deferred_decisions.stable_ci_aggregator: After active workflow PR #542 and Issue #558 become terminal, add one always-emitted required aggregate check and replace individual required contexts with it.
deferred_decisions.action_sha_pinning: Perform as a separate serialized workflow-hardening task after active workflow ownership is terminal.
